Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 02:14:00 -0000
Subject: Intermittent checkout failures — observed heartbeat gaps (06/29 23:50 UTC)

Hi David,

We spotted a series of 500/502 responses on our checkout flow between 2028-06-29T23:50:12Z and 2028-06-29T23:58:47Z (UTC). Our instrumentation shows a gap in the backend heartbeat and a spike in request retries from the client side. Sample timeline: 

- 23:50:12 UTC — first backend 500 observed
- 23:51:05 UTC — client retries escalate (x3)
- 23:55:21 UTC — several successful requests resume

We need two things from Redwood to evaluate SLA impact:
1) Confirmation of the exact service-level window on your side (server-side errors / unavailability) for our account ID PP-NE-41.
2) A downloadable log bundle or pointers to traces around the window (we captured a small snippet attached).

Attached: logs-snippet.txt (excerpt of client-side timing and response codes).

PulsePay is preparing a formal SLA claim; please advise on next steps and an estimated ETA for your evidence bundle.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
SRE Team — PulsePay
ops_lead@pulsepay.com

- Can you confirm whether you were pinned to a specific region/zone for that traffic (us-west-2 or multi-region)? It helps narrow the trace set.

Best,
